Name: Trypophobialess
Author: MilaUwU13
Description:
[color=#ea9999][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/color]
[font=Arial][color=#f4cccc]This mod changes some item textures to make them more comfortable to look at for people with trypophobia^^
The aim is to create 1 mod that will fix as many issues in this field as possible, so feel free to let me know of any textures from any mod that you think could use a version with less holes;3[/color][/font]
[color=#f4cccc][b][font=Arial]EVERY FEATURE OF THIS MOD CAN BE TURNED ON/OFF SEPARATELY IN THE CONFIG! PLAYERS CAN ALSO CHOOSE THE STYLE OF SOME TEXTURES THERE! (By default some texture styles are set to be automatic)[/font][/b][/color]

[color=#cc0000][size=4][b]Changes:[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#e06666]Makes the Morel texture less hole-y[/color][/*]
[*][color=#e06666]Changes the Morel shirt accordingly[/color][/*]
[*][color=#e06666]Replaces the Morel look when used in the sprites of other mods (the ones I know of)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#e06666]Changes the Basalt texture[/color][/*]
[*][color=#e06666]Replaces some tree textures[/color][/*]
[*][color=#e06666]Replaces some textures in the mines (especially slime version of the mines)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#e06666]Replaces scorpion dens from SVE (if the mod is installed)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#e06666]Replaces Smelly Rafflesia, Flower Cookie and Seed Cookie from SVE (if the mod is installed)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#e06666]Changes the Almond texture from Cornucopia (if the mod is installed)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#e06666]Changes the False Morel from Alchemistry (if the mod is installed) [/color][/*]
[*][color=#e06666]Replaces the Lichii berry texture from Pokemon Eggventure (if the mod is installed)[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Installation instructions:[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Just drop the mod folder into the Mods folder (remember that it has to be a folder and not a .zip file!)[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]
[list]

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url][/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Compatibility:[/size][/b]
